title: Saudi Lamb Tagine
description: A flavorful and aromatic tagine dish made with lamb, inspired by Saudi cuisine. This keto-friendly recipe is perfect for a special occasion or a cozy night in.

ingredients.name: tagine
ingredients.notes: traditional clay pot or Dutch oven

instructions: Preheat the tagine or Dutch oven over medium heat.
Add the olive oil and sauté the lamb until browned, about 5 minutes.
Add the cumin, coriander, cinnamon, and ginger. Stir well to combine.
Add 1 cup of water to the tagine and bring to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low and simmer, covered, for 1 1/2 hours, or until the lamb is tender.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve hot, garnished with fresh parsley or cilantro.
